affected_boundaries: host session state to authenticated worker delivery and checkout recovery

observed_behavior: Four idle GWEN worker sessions with authenticated deliveries were reported as active and blocking after their checkouts disappeared.
expected_behavior: A waiting or completed managed session with an exact authenticated delivery is an idle delivered milestone; checkout loss remains visible but does not block integration or independent dispatch when the branch tip and host identity match.
causal_mechanism: The scheduler equated a finished worker turn with the host's completed state, but Codex reports retained idle chats as waiting. Its missing-checkout path also accepted mere commit existence without checking the assigned branch tip.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A host conversation lifecycle label was reused as delivery-completion evidence instead of combining the authenticated delivery with observed session identity and Git branch state.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: The waiting state masks a valid delivery and converts a recoverable checkout loss into a global blocking diagnostic. Commit existence alone would admit a branch that no longer names the delivered revision.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: A fresh complete host observation of the managed waiting or completed session at its assigned path, authenticated delivery, and exact assignment branch tip jointly prove the finished worker milestone; a changed branch or active worker does not.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Classify exact waiting deliveries with and without the checkout, require a matching branch tip after checkout loss, and allow the existing recovery predicate for delivered waiting workers needing rebase.

applicability_conditions: The worker has an authenticated clean delivery and its native Codex session is idle in the waiting state.
The scheduler has a fresh complete host observation and a surviving assignment branch.
known_non_matches: A working session has not finished its current turn.
A changed branch tip or missing authenticated delivery does not prove the delivered revision is current.
confirmation_evidence: The real-Git regression first classified a waiting delivered worker as ACTIVE both before and after checkout loss.
The same regression passes after the correction and still blocks a changed branch tip.
regression_proofs: tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: waiting worker delivery remains integrable before and after its checkout disappears
tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: delivered waiting worker with a missing checkout recovers before rebase and preserves delivery
